vtrmc-2011-02.prompt:
A sequence $(a_n)$ is defined by $a_0=-1$, $a_1=0$, and
$$a_{n+1}=a_n^2-(n+1)^2a_{n-1}-1$$
for all positive integers $n$. Find $a_{100}$.

vtrmc-2011-04.prompt: Let $m,n$ be positive integers and let $[a]$ denote the residue class mod $mn$ of the integer $a$ (thus $\{[r]\mid r\text{ is an integer}\}$ has exactly $mn$ elements). Suppose the set $\{[ar]\mid r\text{ is an integer}\}$ has exactly $m$ elements. Prove that there is a positive integer $q$ such that $q$ is prime to $mn$ and $[nq]=[a]$.
vtrmc-2011-04.answer: The multiples of $a$ mod $mn$ number $mn/\gcd(a,mn)$, so $\gcd(a,mn)=n$, $a=sn$ with $\gcd(s,m)=1$; then pick $q\equiv s\pmod m$ coprime to $mn$.

vtrmc-2011-06.prompt: Let $S$ be a set with an asymmetric relation $<$; this means that if $a,b\in S$ and $a<b$, then we do not have $b<a$. Prove that there exists a set $T$ containing $S$ with an asymmetric relation $\prec$ with the property that if $a,b\in S$, then $a<b$ if and only if $a\prec b$, and if $x,y\in T$ with $x\prec y$, then there exists $t\in T$ such that $x\prec t\prec y$ ($t\in T$ means "$t$ is an element of $T$").
vtrmc-2011-06.answer: Take $T=S\times\mathbb Q$ with the lexicographic relation $(a,p)\prec(b,q)\iff a<b$ or ($a=b$ and $p<q$), identifying $s\in S$ with $(s,0)$.

vtrmc-2011-07.prompt: Let $P(x)=x^{100}+20x^{99}+198x^{98}+a_{97}x^{97}+\cdots+a_1x+1$ be a polynomial where the $a_i$ $(1\le i\le97)$ are real numbers. Prove that the equation $P(x)=0$ has at least one complex root (i.e. a root of the form $a+bi$ with $a,b$ real numbers and $b\neq0$).
vtrmc-2011-07.answer: If all roots were real, $\sum x_i=-20$ and $\sum x_i^2=20^2-2\cdot198=4$ give equality in $(\sum x_i)^2\le100\sum x_i^2$, so all $x_i=-\frac15$, contradicting $\prod x_i=1$.
